name: Arc Nest Upholstered Lounge Chair
description: Arc Nest is a single seat lounge chair designed to create a comfortable, self contained place for everyday relaxation. Its wide curved back and wraparound silhouette provide a more supported, enclosed sitting experience, while medium soft cushioning and sinuous spring suspension balance gentle comfort with responsive support for reading, unwinding, or casual conversation. The 38.6-inch-wide profile offers a spacious seat without requiring a full sofa sized footprint, making it practical as an independent seating option or an additional lounge chair. Textured crochet upholstery adds tactile interest while supporting straightforward day to day care; light stains can be spot cleaned with a damp cloth, mild detergent, or a water based upholstery cleaner. Available in Burnt Brick and Blue, Arc Nest combines functional lounge comfort with a distinctive shape that helps define its own seating area.

name: Mellow Velvet Curved 2-Piece Chaise Sectional / 3-Seater Couch Sofa / Lounge Chair
description: Mellow is a velvet sofa collection available as a 2-piece chaise sectional, a 3-seater couch, or a coordinating velvet barrel chair. Its low-profile curved design pairs clean lines with softly rounded corners and foam-padded arms, creating an inviting silhouette that feels relaxed while retaining a structured, modern character. Upholstered in soft performance velvet fabric, Mellow is designed for everyday living, with a 30,000-rub durability rating and 4.5/5 stain resistance. Plush cushioning combines high-resiliency foam with a medium-firm seat feel, providing supportive comfort while helping the seating retain its shape over time. Choose the chaise sectional for stretching out and spacious lounging, the 3-seater couch for streamlined shared seating, or the accent chair for a comfortable place to unwind on your own. The collection is available in versatile Cream and expressive Tangerine velvet. The cream curved sofa brings a light, understated feel to contemporary interiors, while the tangerine couch adds warmth and visual character. For a coordinated seating arrangement, the velvet curved sectional pairs naturally with the Mellow accent chair, creating a cohesive and inviting look throughout the space.

name: Dori Fleece Curved Lounge Chair
description: Dori is a wide, low profile fleece lounge chair designed to create a comfortable standalone seat in the living room. Its 40.2-inch-wide frame, rounded arms, and gently enclosed seat provide generous space for everyday lounging, quiet breaks, or casual conversation, while the single seat design makes it easy to use alongside an existing sofa or as a separate relaxation area. Medium soft cushioning made with high resiliency foam and polyester microfiber offers a relaxed feel with responsive everyday support. The fleece upholstery has a soft, fluffy texture and can be spot cleaned with a damp cloth, mild detergent, or a water based upholstery cleaner for practical day to day care. Webbing and sinuous spring suspension add reliable seat support, while the 330 lb weight capacity and no assembly design make Dori convenient for immediate everyday use. The foam has also been tested by SGS with no detectable PFAS, offering added reassurance during daily relaxation.

name: CushyLand Modular Family Sofa
description: CushyLand is a full-size modular family sofa designed for sitting, lounging, relaxing, and play. Its flexible modules can be easily rearranged into a spacious sofa, a floor-lounging setup, a double bed, or playful structures, allowing it to adapt as your family’s needs and living space evolve over time. Medium-firm, high-resiliency foam provides supportive comfort for both adults and children, while the soft two-tone chenille upholstery adds warmth, texture, and a cozy feel to living rooms, family rooms, bedrooms, studies, and play spaces. Designed for everyday family use, the upholstery is rated for at least 20,000 rubs for enhanced durability. A sturdy construction, metal support frame, and anti-slip pads help keep the modules stable during sitting, lounging, play, and frequent rearrangement. For added peace of mind, CushyLand is CPC certified and meets applicable CPSC child product safety requirements. The foam has been tested by SGS with no detectable PFAS, while the throw pillow fillings are certified to OEKO-TEX® STANDARD 100.

name: Cora Velvet Curved 3-Seater Couch Sofa / Lounge Chair
description: Cora is a three seat curved velvet couch designed to make everyday seating feel more comfortable and easier to maintain. Its continuous rounded back and arms create a clearly defined place for family conversations, watching TV, or hosting guests, while the low profile silhouette helps preserve open sightlines and keeps the room from feeling visually crowded. The fixed seat cushion stays securely in place, reducing the need for frequent adjustment and helping the sofa maintain its smooth, sculptural appearance. Medium firm cushioning with 3.13 PCF high resiliency foam provides steady support without an overly stiff feel and helps the seat retain its shape through regular use. The 87 inch couch accommodates up to three people and supports up to 661 lbs, making it suitable for daily family seating and casual gatherings. Velvet upholstery can be maintained through regular vacuuming, light brushing, and prompt spot cleaning, while foam tested by SGS with no detectable PFAS offers added reassurance for everyday relaxation.
